mcqs.question: Which of the following was listed among the other entities associated with the achievements of the Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool by 7 September 2026?
options: Hoger Offshore and Marine Pvt Ltd
mcqs.explanation: Balrampur Chini Mills was listed among the other entities associated with the Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool’s achievements. Vedanta Sterlite Copper was associated with cargo war, while Hoger Offshore and Marine Pvt Ltd and Shipping Corporation of India were linked to the first policies.
